info.title: MyGPTAssistants SDK & REST API
info.description: Complete API documentation for the My GPT Assistants platform. Build AI-powered chatbots with multi-channel integrations, CRM capabilities, and team management.

bearerAuth.description: JWT token authentication. Use the token received from /api/v1/user/login

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope used by every non-2xx response.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, TENANT_MISMATCH).

field.description: For VALIDATION_ERROR: the offending field path.

requestId.description: Request correlation id for log lookup.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query.

TagDto.description: A tag that can be assigned to CRM resources (contacts, leads, tickets, etc.).

TagAssignmentDto.description: A polymorphic tag→entity link. Joins a Tag to any CRM entity by `(entityType, entityId)`.

ContactDto.description: A contact record — the canonical representation returned by every Contact API.

customFields.description: Tenant-defined custom field values, keyed by field name.
Tenant-defined custom field values, keyed by field name.

AccountDto.description: A business account record (CRM company entity).

TicketDto.description: A support ticket — the canonical CRM ticket shape.

TicketMessageDto.description: A message on a ticket conversation thread.

AppointmentDto.description: A scheduled appointment in the CRM calendar.

NotificationDto.description: A notification delivered to a user.

NoteDto.description: A CRM note attached to a polymorphic parent entity.

TaskDto.description: A CRM task (manual or bot work-order).

StageDto.description: A stage within a sales pipeline.

OpportunityDto.description: A sales opportunity tracked through a pipeline.

CampaignDto.description: A marketing campaign (email, SMS, or notification).

CustomFieldDto.description: A tenant-defined custom field on a CRM entity.

CustomFieldValueDto.description: A value of a custom field for a specific entity.

SequenceStepDto.description: A single step within a drip sequence.

SequenceEnrollmentDto.description: A contact enrollment in a drip sequence — tracks per-contact progress.

WorkflowDto.description: An automation workflow triggered by a CRM event.

SegmentDto.description: A named filter expression over CRM contacts.

BotDto.description: A bot/assistant — the canonical record returned by every Bot API. Uses a string id (CUID), not an integer.

BotAppearanceDto.description: Visual customization for a bot’s chat widget.

BotJobDto.description: A scheduled or manually-triggered bot work-order.

BotJobRunDto.description: A single execution run of a BotJob.

BotIntegrationDto.description: A channel integration for a bot (Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/etc). Secrets and tokens are omitted by design.

BotPlaygroundMessageDto.description: A single message in a playground chat.

UserDto.description: A platform user. Password and auth secrets are intentionally omitted.

SubscriptionPlanDto.description: A subscription plan available for teams.

TeamSubscriptionDto.description: A team's active or historical subscription record.

TeamBillingInfoDto.description: A team's billing profile (tax + payment metadata).

AuditLogDto.description: A single tamper-evident audit-log entry. Append-only — the chain fields (contentHash, previousHash, merkleRoot, signature) form a verifiable ledger.

IdentityProviderDto.description: A tenant-scoped SSO identity provider configuration. The `config` field is provider-specific (SAML2/OIDC/OAuth2/LDAP shapes vary). Sensitive sub-fields like `privateCert` and `clientSecret` are redacted on read.

config.description: Provider-specific configuration. Sensitive fields are redacted.

ResellerProfileDto.description: A tenant-scoped reseller profile for the referral / partner program. Decimal monetary fields are emitted as strings to preserve precision.

DataConsentDto.description: A GDPR consent record attached to a Contact.

DataSubjectRequestDto.description: A GDPR Data Subject Access Request (DSAR). 30-day SLA per regulation.

dueDate.description: GDPR mandates a 30-day SLA from requestedAt.

DataRetentionPolicyDto.description: Per-team data retention rule for automated cleanup of expired records (SOC2 CC6.6).

FormSubmissionDto.description: A single submission against a form.

data.description: Submitted values, shaped by the form fields configuration

EmailLogDto.description: An append-only email communication log entry.

SmsLogDto.description: An append-only SMS communication log entry.

NotificationPreferenceDto.description: A user-scoped notification-channel toggle. Keyed by `(userId, type)` per the unique index.

EmailPreferenceDto.description: The current user's global email-notification opt-in flag. Single boolean — not per-type.

CrmOverviewReport.description: High-level CRM KPIs aggregated for the current team.

TeamMemberDto.description: A team-member record. `inviteToken` and `inviteTokenExpiresAt` are intentionally omitted from the read shape. `username` is joined from the `User` relation, and `status` is derived: `joinedAt != null` → `ACTIVE`, else `INVITED`.

get.summary: Get current handoff status for widget chat session
get.description: Widget polls this endpoint to check if conversation has been handed off to a human agent. Returns the current state (BOT_ACTIVE, CONNECTING, HANDOFF_ACTIVE, RESOLVED) and agent info if connected.

parameters.name: lastSeq
parameters.description: Highest botWebHistory seq the widget has already received. Server returns agent messages with seq greater than this value.

parameters.name: offline
parameters.description: When truthy (e.g. "1" sent via navigator.sendBeacon on pagehide/unload), marks the widget visitor as OFFLINE so the agent ticket UI reflects departure immediately.

messages.description: Agent messages with seq greater than the client-supplied lastSeq (HTTP polling delivery fallback).

get.summary: SSE stream for real-time handoff events
get.description: Server-Sent Events endpoint for receiving real-time agent messages and status changes during an active handoff session. Rate limited to 5 connections per minute.

post.summary: Send customer message during active live handoff
post.description: Widget calls this endpoint (instead of the bot chat endpoint) when a live handoff is active. The message is stored in the ticket thread and pushed to the agent in real-time.

get.summary: Poll agent messages during live handoff (SSE fallback)
get.description: HTTP polling endpoint for fetching agent messages when SSE is unavailable. Returns messages from botWebHistory with seq greater than afterSeq.

parameters.name: afterSeq
parameters.description: Fetch messages with seq greater than this value

post.summary: Beacon endpoint to mark widget OFFLINE on tab close
post.description: Called via navigator.sendBeacon from the widget when pagehide/beforeunload fires. Flips the active live handoff presence to OFFLINE so CRM agents see the user left.
